# sqlpipe v2.0 Release Notes

## Breaking Changes

CAUTION: The `name` field of `/v2/users` is removed. Update your clients before you upgrade.

The `/v2/users` endpoint now returns two fields, `first_name` and `last_name`. The old `name` field no longer exists. If a client reads `name`, the client fails. Split your name handling into the two new fields.

## New Features

You can now run incremental syncs with the `--incremental` flag. sqlpipe copies only the rows that changed since the last run.

## Improvements

Parquet writes are 40% faster in this release.
